title: Zoho Analytics Announces a Major Evolution #Shorts
description:
Zoho Analytics has announced a major evolution. Discover how this update helps businesses streamline reporting and build unified dashboards.

1. Open Zoho Analytics and integrate your live Zoho CRM and Zoho Books workspaces.
2. Click Ask Zia and type conversational prompts like 'Compare quarterly revenue growth versus pipeline velocity'.
3. Pin the automatically generated visual reports directly to your executive dashboard.

AI + Zoho automations every day - follow @GSXAutomation

What inspired this: https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiekFVX3lxTE5xSU1YTnFsbjNtQTBpUHJBOU91MU5weV96TkdqQ2JmcVVkaE9LZ0FETmpUaTdQSjZIWUJkTEphd29XQXpYblpfaW5rOV80SkdJV0RiSUF3Wm9RdERQTEtJUTA1Ry1MZWJuenowTWlxSUFTUVVxUV9rMHpn?oc=5

This video uses an AI-generated presenter and voice.
Independent channel. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Zoho Corporation. Zoho is a trademark of Zoho Corporation.

angle.problem: Executives wait days for BI teams to write custom SQL reports across sales and financial data.
angle.solution: Use Zia Insights in Zoho Analytics' evolution to generate conversational BI dashboards.
steps: Open Zoho Analytics and integrate your live Zoho CRM and Zoho Books workspaces.
Click Ask Zia and type conversational prompts like 'Compare quarterly revenue growth versus pipeline velocity'.
Pin the automatically generated visual reports directly to your executive dashboard.
angle.result: Delivers real-time executive reporting without writing complex SQL queries.
angle.wow: Zia automatically generates complete multi-app analytical charts from plain English prompts.
angle.hook: Zoho Analytics just launched a major evolution—here is how to use it!

script.title: Zoho Analytics Announces a Major Evolution

lines.say: Zoho Analytics just announced a major evolution, bringing powerful new upgrades to modern business intelligence and enterprise reporting.
lines.tts: Zoho Analytics just announced a major evolution, bringing powerful new upgrades to modern business intelligence and enterprise reporting.

lines.say: Growing organizations frequently struggle with fragmented data scattered across multiple departments, making it difficult to monitor overall business performance effectively.
lines.tts: Growing organizations frequently struggle with fragmented data scattered across multiple departments, making it difficult to monitor overall business performance effectively.

lines.say: This major evolution from Zoho Analytics streamlines data analysis and helps teams unlock clearer operational insights without complicated setups.
lines.tts: This major evolution from Zoho Analytics streamlines data analysis and helps teams unlock clearer operational insights without complicated setups.

lines.say: To get started, open Zoho Analytics and access your central workspace to view your connected business data sources.
lines.tts: To get started, open Zoho Analytics and access your central workspace to view your connected business data sources.

lines.say: Next, generate customized analytical reports to track essential organizational metrics and evaluate key operational trends across your company.

screen.heading: Analytical Reports
screen.tip: Select analytical reports to evaluate performance

lines.say: Finally, arrange your visual reports into clean dashboards so your stakeholders can monitor vital business indicators in real time.

screen.heading: Executive Dashboard
screen.tip: Organize reports into an executive dashboard

lines.say: Your organization now enjoys a modern analytics workflow that delivers clearer visibility and accelerates strategic decision-making across departments.
